2026.cancellation_plain: Cancel at least 3 working days before the event and we refund your deposit in full. Cancel 1 to 2 working days before and the deposit is kept. Cancel on the day of the event and the full order value is charged. Working days are Monday to Friday, excluding Singapore public holidays.
